hero.subtitle: We take over your ongoing content production. Your product data becomes posts, reels, carousels and articles that go out on your channels on a regular schedule. The monthly volume is agreed up front.

visual_demo.heading: One topic. Six formats. Every channel.

modules.heading: What PRIZMA produces
modules.subheading: Publishing regularly is no longer enough. Algorithms weigh consistency, topical relevance and how people behave. PRIZMA builds the formats you need from a single topic, each one tuned to its channel.

items.name: Post
items.desc: A post with a clear message about your product or offer. Image and text fit each other and the channel.

items.name: Reel
items.desc: A short video with a clear message. Platforms show reels to people who don't follow you yet, so you reach new people without an ad budget.

items.name: Carousel
items.desc: Complex ideas, broken down clearly. Carousels earn saves and shares. The kind of content people bookmark and come back to.

items.name: Story
items.desc: Short and current. Stories keep your channels present between the larger posts and are usually seen first.

items.name: Article
items.desc: An article for search. PRIZMA analyses real search queries and shapes the text around them.

items.name: Avatar
items.desc: A face for your brand, with no camera and no shoot. The AI avatar delivers your script on video, regularly and at consistent quality.

why.heading: You provide the product data. We deliver the content.
why.text: There is no shortage of content software, but someone still has to run it. With PRIZMA you don't need anyone in-house for that. We pick topics from your catalog, produce the right format for each channel and publish on schedule. The texts sound like your company and target real search queries. You decide what gets checked before it goes out.

items.title: Online retailers
items.desc: Your range stays visible on your channels: products, prices and promotions that also get found in search.

items.title: Manufacturers and brands
items.desc: Product data and in-house know-how become content that customers find and understand.

items.title: Travel agencies
items.desc: Offers stay visible continuously, without anyone preparing them one by one.

items.title: Agencies and resellers
items.desc: We produce for your client brands, each in its own voice. You stay the contact for your clients.

steps.title: Scope
steps.desc: You decide how much content of which kind goes out on which channels.

steps.title: Product data
steps.desc: Catalog, product feed, website or your Telegram channel. If you like, we pick up new topics automatically.

steps.title: Production
steps.desc: PRIZMA researches the topic, aims the text at real search queries and your region, and produces the agreed formats.

steps.title: Publishing
steps.desc: Approval fully automatic, partial or per post, following your rules. Then the post goes live on the agreed channels.

showcase.heading: Content for your industry.
showcase.subtitle: E-commerce, manufacturing, travel. This is the content PRIZMA produces. Most of it is built on our clients' real photos and videos. Whether and where AI is added is the client's call. In the examples, the caption says so.

roadmap.heading: Where PRIZMA is heading
roadmap.subtitle: From automating individual posts to a system that keeps improving the results of your publishing
roadmap.cta_desc: Tell us which features matter most to you

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.lead: You pay for the agreed content. You don't need a software licence or extra staff for it. The price depends on volume, formats, channels and languages. For orientation:

items.label: Setup
items.desc: Analysis of your tone, connection of the channels and first content for review.

items.label: Operation
items.desc: A fixed monthly scope: which content, how much, on which channels. Creation and publishing are included, released under your rules.

pricing.note: All prices are exclusive of statutory VAT. Separate terms apply to agencies and resellers.

trust.heading: Data protection and operations
trust.lead: PRIZMA processes your company content: products, offers, dates and announcements. Access to customer records is not required.

items.title: Contracting party and servers in the EU
items.desc: The contracting party is a company based in Bielefeld and the servers are located within the EU. Contracts, invoicing and support are handled from Germany.

items.title: Processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR
items.desc: We provide a data processing agreement, tailored to how the system is actually used in your company.

items.title: Processing to your specification
items.desc: By default, processing runs on our infrastructure. On request we use a European provider or install the system on a server of your own.

items.title: Approval and control
items.desc: You decide which content is published automatically and which is reviewed first. You also decide whether we work with your own photos and videos or have AI generate images, video or a voice. Your content is used to train AI models only with your consent.
